property_summary: For every successfully filled SHORT order, fillOrder must store the expiration timestamp under the short position's own key uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)); the mutant swaps the ternary and stores it under uint256(orderHash) instead, leaving positionExpirations(oppositeId) at zero, so the rule positionExpirations(hashOppositeOrder(order)) == block.timestamp + duration is broken for every admissible short fill.
change_summary: Swap the ternary so the expiration is written under the opposite position's key.
